resources.string: This panel\'s browser is too old
Vacademy Classroom needs Android System WebView (Chrome) %1$d or newer.
No working Android System WebView was found on this device.
1. Ask the panel vendor for a firmware or Android System WebView update.
2. Use the panel\'s Android or Windows OPS module, if it has one.
3. Open panel.vacademy.io in Chrome on another device and connect it to the panel.
This panel has no screen for that setting.
The panel\'s browser engine stopped %1$d times in the last minute. This usually means the panel is low on memory. Close other apps, then restart Vacademy Classroom.
